entry.title: ATHAMADULET
entry.text: ATHAMADULET, the prime minister of the Perfin empire, as the grand victor is of the Turkish empire. He is great chancellor of the kingdom, pre-fident of the conced, imperirendment of the finances, and is charged with all foreign affairs.
